messages:
kai: quick convo: should a runtime flag rollout consult tenant quota headroom before ramping beyond safe_pct?
meera: yes. observed a cascade when a model with higher token churn ramped to 15%. 429s all over.
oscar: propose a preflight call to QuotaService with projected_token_delta and cohort sizes. return allowed:boolean + recommended_max_cohort.
jamie: UX: show the recommended_max_cohort as a suggestion on the slider and color the preflight row with a reason.
kai: defaults: require >=30% headroom to auto-ramp above 10%. otherwise block and require 2-person override.
meera: edge-case: burst quotas. QuotaService should include burst_remaining and burst_window so preflight can reason about short spikes.
oscar: agree. also account for routing table: if rollout changes variant weights with different token multipliers, aggregate across table.
jamie: API sketch: POST /internal/rollout_preflight {rollout_id, proposed_config, time_window} -> {allowed, reasons[], recommended_max_cohort, projection_url}. keep payload tiny.
ops-bot: preflight-start: r-2026-05-12-01 by kai cohorts=[5,10,20] at 1762110000
meera: testing: add a simulation mode that replays N hours of sampled traffic and returns a 95th percentile projected increase. flag it as advisory.
kai: privacy: for pii_sensitive tenants, preflight must mask request bodies and limit traces. default to conservative masking.
oscar: console behavior: if recommended_max_cohort < user requested, show blocking confirmation and record override in config_audit with operator + reason + ttl.
jamie: monitoring: on rollout start emit /internal/rollout_watch {rollout_id, cohort, preflight_hash, expected_token_delta}. if actual tokens > expected +10% in first 10m, emit soft_pause event.
meera: implement a short cooldown for automated adjustments to avoid oscillation. exponential backoff for automated weight changes.
oscar: CLI: rwdctl preflight <rollout_id> to fetch last preflight summary and rwdctl simulate --hours 24 to run replay locally.
kai: decision: ship advisory preflight first, conservative gating defaults (headroom>=30% to auto-ramp beyond 10%), no auto-quota changes.
meera: action items: kai=api spec, oscar=QuotaService hook, jamie=console mock + audit flow, meera=simulation harness.
ops-bot: saved-thread: preflight-quota-headroom-checks at 1762111300
jamie: thanks folks, will post Figma and a tiny openapi snippet in the PR.
meera: no objections.
oscar: no objections.
kai: closing, will open repo and ping ops channel for staging validation.
